# CORE CATEGORIES & PRODUCT ENTITIES
1. Heating: Trade-grade heating systems, energy-efficient Worcester Bosch combi boilers, designer radiators, and precision boiler spares.
2. Plumbing: Professional plumbing supplies, internal pipework, copper piping, compression fittings, and valves.
3. Roofing: Advanced roofing pipe and fittings, robust soil pipes, and vent terminals for leak-proof drainage.
4. Guttering: High-capacity rainwater systems, PVC/metal external drainage, downpipes, and hoppers.
5. Renewables: Sustainable energy technology, solar thermal components, and eco-friendly heating solutions.
6. DIY Supplies: Heavy-duty tools, building hardware, and home improvement essentials.
7. Wastewater & Drainage: Comprehensive internal and external wastewater management components.
